mostWorthwhile.text: Following the cold clouds into the outer reaches was most worthwhile: it resolved whether material carried outward could return.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the broken cloud was less engaging than the direct combinations, though it usefully revealed and performed its next interaction.

surprise.text: The dense clouds could retain cold interiors despite being carried by the expanding hot flow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the inspection clarified the one interaction I could not confidently infer.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the contrast between the jet's narrow impact and its wider, eventually returning flow made me curious about what happens next.
